name: Maximum Stats 200
description: Raises the cap on maximum effective character stats (Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Perception) to 200.  Only effective on builds where the PLAYER_MAX_STR_VALUE / DEX / PER / INT external options exist (CDDA 0.I experimental builds through early 2026, and builds after October 2026).  On builds without stat caps the mod is a harmless no-op.  If using Magiclysm or Xedra Evolved, place this mod after them in your mod list to override their stat caps.

name: PLAYER_MAX_STR_VALUE
//: Sets a cap on maximum effective strength for characters.

name: PLAYER_MAX_DEX_VALUE
//: Sets a cap on maximum effective dexterity for characters.

name: PLAYER_MAX_PER_VALUE
//: Sets a cap on maximum effective perception for characters.

name: PLAYER_MAX_INT_VALUE
//: Sets a cap on maximum effective intelligence for characters.
